PreToolUse.command:
# Log tool usage to .aii/audit.log
echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] Tool: $AII_TOOL_NAME, Event: $AII_HOOK_EVENT" >> .aii/audit.log

# Block modifications to protected files
# Exit code 2 = block the action
if [[ "$AII_TOOL_ARGS" == *".env"* ]]; then
  echo "Protected file - requires manual approval"
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

PostToolUse.command:
# Notification on file changes - customize as needed
# Example: notify-send "File modified" "$AII_TOOL_ARGS"

Stop.command:
# Pre-completion verification hook
# Uncomment checks you want to enforce before agent stops
#
# Available environment variables:
#   $AII_SESSION_ID - Current session ID
#   $AII_ITERATION_COUNT - Number of agent iterations
#   $AII_EXIT_REASON - Why agent is stopping
#   $AII_STOP_HOOK_ACTIVE - Whether stop hook is already active
#
# Exit codes:
#   0 = Allow stop
#   2 = Block stop and continue

# Verify tests pass before stopping
# go test ./... || exit 2

# Verify build succeeds before stopping
# go build ./... || exit 2

# Allow stop by default
exit 0
